blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Monday said it ordered the filing of criminal charges against dismissed Luisiana, Laguna Mayor Jomapher Uy Alvarez over the alleged unlawful appointment of a municipal administrator and unjustified withholding of benefits for former municipal officials. The Ombudsman said it found “sufficient grounds” to file one count each of violation of Sections 3(e) and 3(f) of Republic Act No. 3019, or the Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act, and Article 244 of the Revised Penal Code.
